_: ⭐⭐ ITEM 8, NAME #1 — `ta.nvi` ANSWERED. The seed is 1, and the accumulation rule is confirmed on 399 bars with zero exceptions.
_demand: 25 sites across 2 scripts — the highest-demand name in `r11-remaining-nine.md`, which is why it was captured ALONE.

theSeed._: ⛔⛔ AND BOTH CANDIDATES IN THE WILD WERE WRONG. `r11-remaining-nine.md` asked '100? 1000?' and warned that a wrong seed is a CONSTANT OFFSET that looks plausible forever — every shape right, every crossover right, the number wrong by a factor of ten or a hundred. It is neither: NVI here is a pure multiplicative index starting at UNITY.
theSeed._howItWasReached: ⚠️ THE FIRST CAPTURE COULD NOT SEE IT, AND SAID SO. On the daily chart the loaded window began at bar_index 8061, so the earliest visible nvi was 2557.16 — an accumulated value, not a seed. The probe carries `N02_bar_index_SEED_IS_AT_ZERO` precisely so that this is CHECKED rather than assumed, and it read 8061. Clicking the chart's own `All` range button loaded the full history; TradingView auto-coarsened the timeframe to 1M in doing so, which is recorded here because it bounds what else this capture can be used for.

theAccumulationRule.rule: nvi starts at 1. On a bar where volume FELL against the prior bar, nvi *= (1 + (close - close[1]) / close[1]). Otherwise nvi HOLDS.

measuredOnDaily._: ⭐⭐ A PERFECT SPLIT, 209/209 AND 0/190, WITH NO EXCEPTIONS EITHER WAY. That is what makes this a rule rather than a tendency.

arithmeticWitnesses._: volume ROSE → held at 1, even though price rose 1.07%
a DOWN close on falling volume pulls it below 1 — the index is not floored
volume ROSE → held, unchanged from bar 4 to the last digit

theAccumulationRule._: ⭐ THE WITNESSES ARE THE PROOF, not the counts. The counts say nvi moved on every falling-volume bar; these six say WHAT it moved to, and the multiplication reproduces the vendor's own doubles to the last significant figure.

unchangedVolume._: ⛔ ZERO BARS IN 400 HAD volume == volume[1], so the third case — neither fell nor rose — was never exercised. The probe's `N05_volume_UNCHANGED_flag` exists to detect exactly this and it read 0 everywhere, so the capture KNOWS it did not answer rather than quietly implying it did. ⚠️ An exact volume tie is vanishingly rare on a liquid daily series; settling it needs either a thin symbol or a synthetic series, and until then an implementation must pick a side and SAY it picked one.

_bounds: ⚠️ ONE SYMBOL. The accumulation counts are AMEX:SPY 1D over 400 bars; the seed and the six arithmetic witnesses are the same symbol at 1M, because the full history only loads at a coarser timeframe. The seed is a property of the function, not of the timeframe, so 1 carries over — but nothing here measures nvi across a timeframe CHANGE, and nothing measures it on a symbol whose first bar has no prior volume to compare against.
